privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Folio is a portfolio project: a working example of a book shop. Orders are not really shipped and no money is taken. This page explains what the site stores and why.

sections.title: What we store
items: Account: your name, email and password (the password is only ever stored hashed). If you sign in with Google, we receive only your name, email and profile photo from Google.
Orders: first and last name, email, phone, delivery address and note, and the books you ordered.
Your account area: the addresses you add, your cart and your favourites.
No payment details are stored — the site never asks for card data.

sections.title: Why we use it
items: To recognise you and sign you in.
To place your order and show it in your account.
To keep your cart and favourites across devices.
We do not sell your data, use it for advertising or share it with third parties.

sections.title: Where it is kept
items: Data is stored in a Supabase database; each user can read only their own records.
The site is hosted on Vercel. Google sign-in happens on Google's own page; your Google password never reaches us.

sections.title: In your browser
items: Your language, theme (dark/light), cart and favourites are kept in the browser's storage (localStorage).
No tracking or advertising cookies are used.

sections.title: Your rights
items: You can change or remove your profile and addresses in your account at any time.
To have your account and all your data deleted, write to {{email}} — it will be removed within a few days.
